body:
Real investigation: checked SHANKPIT's own mainline lobby directly rather than guessing -- same vector stroke font, but with a drop-shadow behind text and real colored buttons instead of a bare keybind list. Ported both: text_draw_string_shadowed wired into draw_string (one change, every screen benefits), draw_menu_button replaces STATE_LOBBY's bare list with real colored buttons + key badges. Two real live bugs found and fixed via an actual Xvfb screenshot: missing ( ) glyphs (silently rendered as ?), and label text overflowing off the button's own right edge -- both fixed and re-screenshotted to confirm. 25/25 physics tests pass.

⚓ ☃
title: BPUX-12444: real UX legibility fix -- drop-shadow text + colored mode buttons, matching SHANKPIT
